rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who turn away after learning God's covenant with the prophets and their transmission of it are transgressors.
rows.anchor: أي: بعدما علم عهد الله مع النبيين وتبليغ الأنبياء إليه ما عهد الله إليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are outside God's religion; every other religion is only notionally valid, not truly so.
rows.anchor: الخارجون عن دين الله ولا دين غيره معتد به في الحقيقة إلا توهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All beings in heaven and earth follow God's religion; no other religion is sought in reality.
rows.anchor: وكل من في السموات والأرض يدين بدينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All submit to God's command: willingly, except humans and Satan; humans and Satan submit unwillingly.
rows.anchor: كالإنسان والشيطان إذ الكفر لا يسع موجودا سواهما، فكلهم ممتثلون لما أمرهم الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humans are veiled by their own will, forget the covenant, and heed Satan through affinity with his psychic darkness; only God's protection and election enable willing faith.
rows.anchor: والإنسان لاحتجابه بإرادته ونسيانه عهد الله وقبوله لدعوة الشيطان لمناسبته إياه بالظلمة النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan's self-admiration, egoism, refusal, and pride constitute disbelief; his boast “I am better than him” expresses it.
rows.anchor: والشيطان لاحتجابه بعجبه وأنيته في قوله: أنا خير منه [الأعراف، الآية: 12] وإبائه، واستكباره كفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although Satan disbelieves through pride, he knows he disobeys and believes under compulsion, recognizing that his disbelief occurs by God's will; this itself is faith.
rows.anchor: وهو مع ذلك يعلم عصيانه ويؤمن كرها، ويتحقق أن كفره بإرادته تعالى وذلك عين الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qashani cites three passages in which Satan disavows his followers and fears God as evidence of Satan's belief, though it comes too late to benefit him.
rows.anchor: فهذه الآيات دالة على إيمانه ولكن حين لا ينفعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the final return, every being acknowledges God's religion and no religion other than His remains.
rows.anchor: فلا يبقى دين غير دين الله بل الكل عند الرجوع يدين بدينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The closing couplet says all would profess the true religion if they understood, since no religion besides truth is prescribed.
rows.anchor: كل يدين بدين الحق لو فطنوا وليس دين لغير الحق مشروع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The revealed Book is detailed knowledge of the attributes and their manifestations and rulings, grounded in truth and justice, enabling judgment among people.
rows.anchor: أي: علم تفاصيل الصفات وأحكام تجلياتها بالحق ملتبسا بالعدل والصدق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet judges by the divine justice God shows him, not by his own self.
rows.anchor: أو قائما بالحق لا بنفسك لتكون حاكما بين الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The traitors fail the primordial trust of knowing God deposited in their capacities, betraying themselves and others by misusing rights.
rows.anchor: الذين لا يؤدون أمانة الله التي أودعها عندهم في الأزل بما ركز في استعدادهم من إمكان كمال معرفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet must not defend traitors from punishment or others' retaliation, or plead that God wronged them; they are wrongdoers with no defense.
rows.anchor: يدفع عنهم العذاب وتسليط الله الخلق عليهم بالإيذاء ويحتج عنهم على غيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeking forgiveness means ceasing to object to God or advocate for the traitors, so God forgives the Prophet's transient self-coloring.
rows.anchor: لنغفر تلوينك الذي ظهر عليك بوجود قلبك وبصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They hide their blameworthy ego traits from people, but do not remove or uproot them before God, who witnesses and knows their inward states.
rows.anchor: بكتمان رذائلهم وصفات نفوسهم التي هي معايبهم عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their secret plotting in the darkness of ego and nature consists of false conjectures and fantasies fabricated to gain worldly goods and pleasures.
rows.anchor: أي: يقدرون في عالم ظلمة النفس والطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God encompasses their deeds and recompenses them according to their dispositions and actions.
rows.anchor: يجازيهم بحسب صفاتهم وأعمالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's favor is enabling support on the spiritual path that actualizes the Prophet's latent perfection and knowledge.
rows.anchor: توفيقه وإمداده لسلوك طريقه بما يخرج كمالك إلى الفعل ويبرز ما فيك كامنا من العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mercy is God's gift of the absolute perfection deposited in the Prophet from eternity, a mercy beyond which none is possible.
rows.anchor: هبته لذلك الكمال المطلق الذي أودعه فيك في الأزل وهي الرحمة التي ليس وراءها رحمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plotters mislead only themselves because misguidance arises from their primordial disposition toward wretchedness and cannot transfer to another.
rows.anchor: لكون الضلال ناشئا من أصل استعدادهم لكونهم مجبولين على الشقاوة أزلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book is complete, detailed knowledge after gifted existence; wisdom is knowledge of detailed rulings and attribute-manifestations together with acting upon them.
rows.anchor: علم أحكام التفاصيل وتجليات الصفات مع العمل به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone knows His own knowledge; after unveiling His essence through annihilation and restoring the Prophet in true existence, the Prophet's heart knows with God's knowledge, since attributes follow essence.
rows.anchor: فلما كشف لك عن ذاته بفنائك فيه ثم أبقاك بالوجود الحقاني فصار قلبك وحجبك بحجاب ذلك القلب علمك علمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's great favor is manifesting this perfection through the practice that brought the Prophet to his attained state.
rows.anchor: في إظهار هذا الكمال عليك بالتوفيق للعمل الذي أوصلك إلى ما أوصلك

words: لَّا خَيْرَ فِى كَثِيرٍۢ مِّن نَّجْوَىٰهُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most private talk is surplus; a spiritual wayfarer should leave what does not concern him.
rows.anchor: فإنها فضول، والفضول يجب تركها على السالك

words: لَّا خَيْرَ فِى كَثِيرٍۢ مِّن نَّجْوَىٰهُمْ
rows.speaker: النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام
rows.claim: The Prophet teaches that part of excellent Islam is leaving what does not concern a person.
rows.anchor: قال عليه الصلاة السلام: " من حسن إسلام المرء تركه ما لا يعنيه ".

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two sons of Adam symbolize the heart's Abel, the intellect, and Cain, the estimative faculty; each has a twin faculty.
rows.anchor: القلب للذين هما هابيل القلب وقابيل الوهم، إذ كان لكل منهما توأمة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The intellect's twin is the practical, deliberative rational faculty, which orders worldly and spiritual life and derives virtuous actions, character, crafts, and governance.
rows.anchor: أما توأمة العقل فالعاقلة العلمية المدبرة لأمور المعاش والمعاد بالآراء الصلاحية المقتضية للأعمال الصالحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The estimative faculty's twin is imagination, which handles sensory and particular meanings in service of satanic opinions.
rows.anchor: وأما توأمة الوهم: فالقوة المتخيلة المتصرفة في المحسوسات والمعاني الجزئية لتحصيل الآراء الشيطانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart pairs estimation with practical reason so demonstrative reasoning and spiritual discipline subdue it to intellect, service, truthful hope, and good works.
rows.anchor: فأمر آدم القلب بتزويج الوهم بتوأمة العقل التي هي العاقلة العلمية لتتسلط عليه بالقياسات العقلية البرهانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart also pairs intellect with imagination, making imagination useful for universal and particular knowledge while curbing corrupt fantasies and false inner talk.
rows.anchor: وتزويج العقل توأمة الوهم ليجعلها صالحة ويمنعها عن شهوات التخيلات الفاسدة

words: فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْءَاخَرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Cain-estimation envies Abel-intellect because the intellect's twin is more beautiful and beloved through her affinity with him.
rows.anchor: فحسد قابيل الوهم هابيل العقل لكون توأمته أجمل عنده وأحب لمناسبتها إياه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart asks each faculty for an offering: intellect offers a valid universal intelligible by yielding a sound conclusion and dissolving the syllogism's form.
rows.anchor: أن يقرب كل واحد منهما قربانا أي: نسكا يتقرب به إلى الله بإفاضة النتيجة وإفناء صورة القياس

words: فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْءَاخَرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Intellect's offering is accepted because its universal intelligible conforms to reality; estimation's fallacious or partial imagined form is rejected as nonconforming.
rows.anchor: وقبول الصورة المعقولة الكلية المطابقة لما في نفس الأمر التي هي نسيكته التي يتقرب بها إلى الله

words: فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْءَاخَرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Estimation's offering is not accepted because it yields no conclusion and its imaginary image does not match reality, deepening its envy.
rows.anchor: وعدم قبول قربان الوهم الذي هو صورة المغالطة أو الصورة الموهومة الجزئية امتناع اتصال العقل به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As intellect draws nearer to God and leaves estimation behind, estimation tries to undo its work through doubts opposing reason in difficult theoretical inquiry.
rows.anchor: لما زاد قرب العقل من الله وبعده عن رتبة الوهم في مدركاته وتصرفاته كان الوهم أحرص على إبطال عمله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Killing means stopping intellect's proper activity and cutting off the spirit's aid and the guidance-light that sustains it.
rows.anchor: وقتله عبارة عن منعه عن فعله وقطع مدد الروح ونور الهداية الذي به حياة العقل عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The God-fearing either take God as protection when doing good or guard against dark bodily dispositions, lies, misguidance, destructive desires, and ruinous suggestions.
rows.anchor: الذين يتخذون الله وقاية في صدور الخيرات منهم أو يحذرون آثام الهيئات المظلمة البدنية والأكاذيب الباطلة

words: مَآ أَنَا۠ بِبَاسِطٍۢ يَدِىَ إِلَيْكَ لِأَقْتُلَكَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Intellect will not destroy estimation's useful sensory work or its life through soul and desire, because each has a proper function.
rows.anchor: لأني لا أبطل أعمالك التي هي شديدة في مواضعها من المحسوسات ولا أقطع عنك حياتك التي هي مدد النفس والهوى

words: مَآ أَنَا۠ بِبَاسِطٍۢ يَدِىَ إِلَيْكَ لِأَقْتُلَكَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Intellect knows that partial interests, sensory judgments, and arranging livelihood depend on estimation; without its hopes and aspirations, people could not sustain themselves.
rows.anchor: إذ العقل يعلم أن المصالح الجزئية وأحكام المحسوسات والمعاني الجزئية المعلقة بها وترتيب أسباب المعاش كلها لا تحصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qashani cites the verse that only the learned truly fear God to explain Abel's fear as knowledge of God.
rows.anchor: وقال: إنما يخشى الله من عباده العلماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Intellect does not interfere with estimation because it knows God created it for a purpose and wisdom.
rows.anchor: واعلم بأنه إنما خلقك لشأن وأوجدك لحكمة، فلا أتعرض له في ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abel wants Cain to bear the sin of killing him and the guilt of Cain's rejected false opinions and corrupt conceptions.
rows.anchor: بإثم قتلي وإثم قتلك من الآراء الباطلة والتصورات الفاسدة التي لم يتقبل قربانك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire is the fire of veiling and deprivation; wrongdoers place things wrongly, as when sensory judgments are applied to intelligible realities.
rows.anchor: الواضعين الأشياء في غير موضعها كوضعك الأحكام الحسية في المعقولات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul makes murder easy by persuading estimation to stop intellect's proper activity and veil it from guidance.
rows.anchor: بمنعه عن أفعاله الخاصة وحجبه عن نور الهداية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Estimation's victory harms the soul by replacing intellect's guidance and sound judgment with its own error; unsupported by reason, it stirs damaging appetites and excess.
rows.anchor: لتضرره باستيلائه على العقل واستبدال ضلالته وخطئه بهداية العقل وصوابه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unrestrained estimation incites greedy pursuit of wealth and rank and animal pleasures; excess can weaken or destroy estimation itself.
rows.anchor: مثل شدة الحرص في طلب المال والجاه والإفراط فيضعف الوهم أيضا أو يبطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The raven symbolizes greed, which digs in the soul's earth and shows estimation how to conceal the slain intellect.
rows.anchor: فبعث الله } غراب الحرص { يبحث في

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Deprived of intellect's guidance, estimation is confused and cannot pursue higher-world perfection; greed leads it through error to bury reason in the dark soul.
rows.anchor: فانبعث الحرص فهداه في تيه الضلالة وأراه كيف يواري ويدفع عورته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The buried worldly intellect is reason severed from spirit and mixed with estimation and desire, hidden in the soul's darkness and consumed by natural powers serving pleasure.
rows.anchor: وهو صورة العقل المنقطع عن حياة الروح المشوب بالوهم والهوى المحجوب عن عالمه في ظلمات أرض النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The raven's buried fledgling represents a faculty's potential or perfection concealed in the soul by suppressing and hiding its products; Cain regrets loss and deprivation.
rows.anchor: الذي دفن فرخه أي: داعيته أو كماله في أرض النفس بإفناء ما يحصل له وكتمانه فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qashani allows that God, the Messenger, and believers take charge of you, or that you take God and His Messenger and believers as allies; veiled people cannot be God's allies because of their real opposition.
rows.anchor: أي: يتولى الله ورسوله والمؤمنون إياكم أو لا يتولى الله وأولياءه من الرسول والمؤمنين المحجوبون للتضاد الحقيقي بينهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse first states the allies' relation to God collectively, then distinguishes Messenger and believers outwardly, as in the testimony verse.
rows.anchor: جمع أولا في إثبات ولايتهم لله مطلقا ثم فصلها بحسب الظاهر، فقال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Establishing prayer means the prayer of witnessing and presence of the divine essence; giving zakah means the remnant's subsistence.
rows.anchor: صلاة الشهود والحضور الذاتي { ويؤتون } زكاة البقايا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bowing is humility in subsistence through God, attributing one's perfections and attributes to God rather than standing arrogantly in them as one's own.
rows.anchor: خاضعون في البقاء بالله بنسبة كمالاتهم وصفاتهم إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qashani identifies the verse's revealed referent as the Commander of the Faithful, who professed divine unity after creation's annihilation.
rows.anchor: كأمير المؤمنين عليه السلام النازل في حقه هذا القائل: لا إله إلا الله بعد فناء الخلق

words: وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever allies with God, the Messenger, and believers belongs to God's people.
rows.anchor: فهو من أهل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's people are victorious through God.
rows.anchor: فهو من أهل الله، وإن أهل الله { هم الغالبون } بالله.

words: ومن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gravest fabricators claim perfection, unity, and freedom from ego multiplicity while ego traits remain; their acts are self-driven despite claiming to act through God.
rows.anchor: بادعاء الكمال والوصول إلى التوحيد والخلاص عن كثرة صفات النفس وازدحامها مع بقائها فيه

words: أو قال أوحي إلي ولم يوح إليه شيء
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: False prophets mistake fantasies and inventions of imagination, intellect, and thought for revelation from God and effusion from the holy spirit.
rows.anchor: أي: حسب مفتريات وهمه وخياله ومخترعات عقله وفكره وحيا من عند الله وفيضا من الروح القدسي

words: ومن قال سأنزل مثل ما أنزل الله
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The claimant to bring revelation like God's has become pharaonic through ego, mistakes conceptual unity for realized unity, and claims divinity.
rows.anchor: أي: تفرعن بوجود أنائيته وتوهم التوحيد العلمي عينيا، فادعى الإلهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongdoers in the death scene are false claimants to perfection, veiled people who call ego-driven acts divine, false prophets, and would-be pharaohs.
rows.anchor: أي: هؤلاء الظلمة من المدعين للكمال المحجوبين الذين يزعمون كون أفعالهم إلهية وهي نفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Death's agonies expose their error: they remained attached to bodies and worldly desire, never undergoing voluntary death, detachment from bodily pleasures, or annihilation of ego traits.
rows.anchor: لافتقادهم في دعواهم وغلطهم في حسبانهم أنهم قد فنوا عن أنفسهم وتجردوا عن ملابس أبدانهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels symbolize the planetary and celestial forces that sustained their psychic powers in life, despite their belief that spiritual detachment freed them from those forces.
rows.anchor: أي: قوى العالم التي كانت تمد قواهم النفسانية من النفوس الكوكبية والفلكية وتأثيراتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The forces extend their hands with full strength and effect against them.
rows.anchor: قوية التأثير فيهم، بالغة فيه كنه قواها وقدرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command is a harsh rebuke and overpowering, intensified by their attachment to bodies and anguish at separation.
rows.anchor: أي: تعنفهم وتقهرهم لشدة تعكفهم وكثرة تحسرهم وصعوبة مفارقة الأبدان عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their humiliating punishment follows their dark ego traits and claims of selfhood and divinity, as another verse says God will requite their description.
rows.anchor: كما قال: سيجزيهم وصفهم [الأنعام، الآية: 139]

words: بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are punished for attributing their ego-driven words and deeds to God and for arrogant attachment to selfhood instead of effacing it for divine attributes.
rows.anchor: أي: بسبب افترائكم على الله، أعمالكم وأقوالكم الصادرة من صفات نفوسكم وأهوائها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They proudly cling to their own traits and pharaonic ego, refusing to efface them in favor of God's attributes.
rows.anchor: وبسبب احتجابكم بأنائيتكم وتفرعنكم معجبين بصفاتكم غير مذعنين بمحوها لصفاتنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People arrive alone, stripped of traits, attachments, family, and individual existence through absorption in the unity of the essence.
rows.anchor: مجردين عن الصفات والعلائق والأهل والأقارب والوجود بالاستغراق في عين جمع الذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first creation is the origination of individual identities in eternity when the primordial covenant was taken.
rows.anchor: بإنشاء ذرات هوياتكم في الأزل عند أخذ الميثاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What God granted and they leave behind includes worldly means, knowledge, and virtues.
rows.anchor: من الوسائل والعلوم والفضائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their supposed intercessors are the means, causes, beloved objects, and idols to which they attached themselves and attributed influence.
rows.anchor: وسائلكم وأسبابكم وما آثرتموه بهواكم وتعلقتم بها من محبوباتكم ومعبوداتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The supposed independent entities vanish when all things are witnessed in God.
rows.anchor: شيئا موجودا بشهودكم ثناء الكل في الله

words: لِيُبْدِىَ لَهُمَا مَا وُۥرِىَ عَنْهُمَا مِن سَوْءَٰتِهِمَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inclination to nature exposes what detachment had concealed: bodily pleasures, moral vices, animal acts, predatory and bestial traits that reason deems shameful.
rows.anchor: ليظهر عليهما بالميل إلى الطبيعة ما حجب عنهما عند التجرد من الأمور الطبيعية واللذات البدنية والرذائل الخلقية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan deceives them into imagining that bodily nature and matter offer angelic pleasures, perceptions, actions, and permanence.
rows.anchor: أوهمهما أن في الاتصال بالطبيعة الجسمانية والمادة الهيولانية لذات ملكية وإدراكات وأفعالا وخلودا فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If ملكين is read with kasra on the lām, Satan promises lasting rule over the faculties and animals.
rows.anchor: أو ملكا ورياسة على القوى وسائر الحيوانات دائما بغير زوال إن قرئ ملكين بكسر اللام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan's promise echoes the tree of immortality and an imperishable kingdom in the cited verse.
rows.anchor: كما قال: أدلك على شجرة الخلد وملك لا يبلى [طه، الآية: 120]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan disguises partial worldly benefits and sensory ornaments, attainable only through bodily instruments, as sincere advice.
rows.anchor: وزين لها من المصالح الجزئية والزخارف الحسية التي لا تنال إلا بالآلات البدنية في صورة الناصح الأمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qist means justice and uprightness.
rows.anchor: أي: العدالة والاستقامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Establishing one's face means keeping the self from excess or deficiency in justice and from spiritual fluctuation in uprightness.
rows.anchor: ذواتكم الموجودة بمنعها عن الميل والزيغ إلى طرفي الإفراط والتفريط في العدالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A mosque here is each station of prostration or each time of prostration.
rows.anchor: أي: كل مقام سجود أو وقت سجود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first prostration is submission and obedience: worship sincerely, avoid ostentation and hypocrisy, obey commands with truthful intent, and do not disobey.
rows.anchor: سجود الانقياد والطاعة وإقامة الوجه فيه بالإخلاص، والاجتناب عن الرياء والنفاق في العمل لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The second prostration is annihilation in actions: fulfill its due while seeing neither oneself nor anything besides God as an agent.
rows.anchor: وسجود الفناء في الأفعال وإقامة الوجه فيه بالقيام بحقه بحيث لا يرى هو مؤثرا غير الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The third prostration is annihilation in attributes, observing its conditions without self-admiration, while avoiding neglect of right action and anger at opponents.
rows.anchor: وسجود الفناء في الصفات، وإقامة الوجه عنده بالمحافظة على شرائطه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fourth prostration is annihilation in essence: efface the remainder and ego-duality without falling into egoic excess or abandoning obedience.
rows.anchor: وسجود الفناء في الذات، وإقامة الوجه عنده بالغيبة عن البقية، والانطماس بالكلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sincerity at the first station dedicates action to God; at the second and third it sees religion and obedience as from God; at the fourth it sees through God.
rows.anchor: في المقام الأول بتخصيص العمل لله به، وفي الثاني والثالث برؤية الدين والطاعة من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the final station, God is the one practicing religion, with no share in it for anyone else.
rows.anchor: فيكون الله هو المتدين بدينه ليس لغيره فيه نصيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God began by making people manifest while hidden; they return by annihilation in Him and concealment so that He appears.
rows.anchor: بفنائكم فيه واختفائكم ليظهر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One group is guided along this path.
rows.anchor: إليهم بهذا الطريق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The other group is condemned to error because it takes estimation and imagination, the psychic powers, as devils and allies apart from God.
rows.anchor: بسبب اتخاذهم شياطين القوى النفسانية الوهمية والتخيلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They imagine themselves guided because the estimative faculty rules through conjecture.
rows.anchor: لأن سلطان الوهم بالحسبان

words: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever is invoked besides God, human or otherwise, is a servant like the worshippers, equally unable and without independent effect.
rows.anchor: كائنين من كانوا، ناسا كانوا أو غيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Challenge those invoked to provide what God has not enabled; their failure disproves the attribution of independent efficacy.
rows.anchor: إلى أمر لا ييسره الله لكم { فليستجيبوا لكم } إلى تيسيره

rows.speaker: النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام
rows.claim: The Prophet tells Ibn Abbas to guard God, ask and seek help only from God, and know that no community can benefit or harm except by what God has written.
rows.anchor: كما قال النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام لابن عباس: " يا غلام، احفظ الله يحفظك، احفظ الله تجده تجاهك.

rows.speaker: النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام
rows.claim: The same report says all benefit and harm are predetermined, with the pens lifted and pages dried.
rows.anchor: كما قال النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام لابن عباس: " يا غلام، احفظ الله يحفظك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question is a denial: although idols have limbs, they do not move independently; God moves them, as with all other organs.
rows.anchor: استفهام على سبيل الإنكار، أي: ألهم أرجل ولكن لا يمشون بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's protector, guardian, and manager is God, who teaches him through revelation and takes charge of every righteous person.
rows.anchor: فإن متولي أمري وحافظي ومدبري هو { الله الذي } يعلمني بتنزيل الكتاب { وهو يتولى } كل صالح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A ṣāliḥ is one who remains upright through divine subsistence after annihilation, firmly established in the unity of essence and authorized to reform humankind.
rows.anchor: وكلما ورد الصالح في وصف نبي من الأنبياء أريد به الباقي بالحق بالاستقامة والتمكين بعد الفناء في عين الجمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet challenges the jinn and human partners to scheme against him, confident that God protects him.
rows.anchor: من الجن والإنس { ثم كيدون } إن استطعتم

words: وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart-sealed see with physical eyes but fail to hear, obey, or perceive the truth and prophetic reality because their hearts are blind.
rows.anchor: إن تدع المطبوع على قلوبهم من المشركين وغيرهم إلى الهدى لا يسمعوا ولا يطيعوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those near their Lord are annihilated in divine unity, subsisting through God in steadfastness.
rows.anchor: بالتوحيد والفناء فيه باقين به ذوي الاستقامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are not arrogant because they are not veiled by ego; they witness differentiation within unity and submit to it.
rows.anchor: بسبب احتجابهم بالأنائية بل يشاهدون التفصيل في عين الجمع فيذعنون له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their glorification denies association by negating selfhood.
rows.anchor: ينزهونه عن الشرك بنفي الأنائية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their prostration is complete annihilation, effacing all remainder and selfhood; God alone remains after creation perishes.
rows.anchor: بالفناء التام، وطمس البقية، وآثار الأينة، والله الباقي بعد فناء الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The companions first received the Prophet's spiritual training and purification; then charity is prescribed because wealth manifests ego, strengthens its traits, and feeds its desires.
rows.anchor: ولما وفقوا للقسم الأول ببركة صحبة الرسول وتزكيته إياهم وتربيته لهم قال:

rows.speaker: النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام
rows.claim: The Prophet calls wealth a source or fuel of desires.
rows.anchor: كما قال عليه الصلاة والسلام: " المال مادة الشهوات "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their first spiritual state should be detachment from wealth, weakening egoic powers and desires and purifying dark dispositions, sins, and satanic impulses.
rows.anchor: فينبغي أن يكون أول حالهم التجرد عن الأموال لتنكسر قوى النفس وتضعف أهواؤها وصفاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praying for them means directing spiritual aspiration and pouring out the light of companionship upon them.
rows.anchor: بإمداد الهمة وإفاضة نور الصحبة عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's attention, spiritual force, and blessed companionship bring tranquility down into their hearts and make them secure.
rows.anchor: إن نورك الذي تفيض عليهم بالتفات خاطرك إليهم وقوة همتك وبركة صحبتك سبب نزول السكينة فيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sakīna is a settled light in the heart that steadies its orientation to God, strengthens certainty, and frees it from satanic and egoic agitation.
rows.anchor: والسكينة نور مستقر في القلب يثبت معه في التوجه إلى الحق ويتقوى اليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears their supplication and confession of sins and knows their intentions, resolve, remorse, and inward grief.
rows.anchor: يسمع تضرعهم واعترافهم بذنوبهم { عليم } يعلم نياتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeking forgiveness means repenting of ego veils, attachment to desire, and idolatry.
rows.anchor: من ذنوب حجب صفات النفس والوقوف مع الهوى بالشرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance is turning toward unity and following its path through detachment and illumination.
rows.anchor: بالتوجه إلى التوحيد والسلوك في طريقه بالتجرد والتنور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spirit's heaven pours down the water of real knowledge and certain gnosis.
rows.anchor: بماء العلوم الحقيقية والمعارف اليقينية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God increases the strength of perfection upon the strength of one's preparedness; turning away instead manifests ego and attachment to the lower world.
rows.anchor: قوة الكمال { إلى } قوة الاستعداد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They deny Hud's clear proof because natural veils limit their understanding and blind their inner sight, preventing them from grasping its demonstration.
rows.anchor: لقصور فهمهم وعمى بصيرتهم عن إدراك البرهان لمكان الغشاوات الطبيعية وإذا لم يدركوه أنكروه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hud's trust in God rests first on God's universal lordship: a Lord manages and protects every creature, so no other guardian is needed.
rows.anchor: بين وجوب التوكل على الله وكونه حصنا حصينا أولا بأن ربوبيته شاملة لكل أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every creature is captive under God's power and cannot independently act or affect another, so there is no need to guard against it.
rows.anchor: ثم بان كل ذي نفس تحت قهره وسلطانه أسير في يد تصرفه ومملكته وقدرته عاجز عن الفعل والقوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's straight path is justice amid multiplicity, a shadow of unity: authority is imposed only on those who deserve it through fault, and punishment follows a lapse, sometimes purifying or raising rank as martyrdom does.
rows.anchor: على طريق العدل في عالم الكثرة الذي هو ظل وحدته فلا يسلط أحدا على أحد إلا عن استحقاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These claims together deny independent power to benefit or harm both people and their idols.
rows.anchor: وفي ضمن ذلك كله نفي القدرة على النفع والضر عنهم وعن آلهتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb sees good in their preparedness: they can attain perfection and accept guidance despite idolatry, greed, and vice.
rows.anchor: إني أراكم بخير في استعدادكم من إمكان حصول كمال وقبول هداية

words: وَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍۢ مُّحِيطٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He fears their sins will surround them because they are veiled from truth, absorbed in livelihood and fleeting gains, neglect the afterlife, and turn toward animal rather than human perfections.
rows.anchor: لاحتجابكم عن الحق ووقوفكم مع الغير وصرف أفكاركم بالكلية إلى طلب المعاش وإعراضكم عن المعاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb urges them to hold to unity and justice and leave idolatry and injustice, the root and totality of vices.
rows.anchor: فلازموا التوحيد والعدالة واعتزلوا عن الشرك والظلم الذي هو جماع الرذائل وأم الغوائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not persist or go to extremes in corruption; injustice is corruption's utmost limit, while justice is the utmost good and gathers the virtues.
rows.anchor: أي: ولا تبالغوا ولا تمادوا في غاية الإفساد فإن الظلم هو الغاية في ذلك كما أن العدل هو الغاية في الصلاح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's remainder is enduring perfection, afterlife bliss, intellectual acquisitions, and scientific and practical gains, better than fleeting earnings whose burdens remain after death.
rows.anchor: فما يبقى لكم عند الله من الكمالات والسعادات الأخروية والمقتنيات العقلية والمكاسب العلمية والعملية خير لكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb turns to his argument after their defiant rejection and mockery of his worship, monotheism, and renunciation, including their taunt about his prayer.
rows.anchor: ولما شاهد إنكارهم وعتوهم في العصيان، واستهزاءهم بطاعته، وزهده وتوحيده وتنزهه بقولهم: { أصلاتك } إلى آخره

words: أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّى
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb asks whether, given certain proof of unity and a good gift from God—wisdom, perfection, and the ability to perfect others—he could abandon his mission.
rows.anchor: من الحكمة العلمية والعملية والكمال والتكميل بالاستقامة في التوحيد، هل يصح لي أن أترك

words: وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He does not seek transient worldly profit by committing the injustice he forbids.
rows.anchor: أي: أن أقصد إلى أجر المنافع الدنيوية الفانية بارتكاب الظلم الذي أنهاكم عنه

words: إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His only aim is to reform himself and his people through purification and preparation to receive wisdom, as far as he can.
rows.anchor: إصلاح نفسي ونفوسكم بالتزكية والتهيئة لقبول الحكمة ما دمت مستطيعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His ability to reform comes only from God; he trusts in God and turns back to Him.
rows.anchor: إلا بالله عليه توكلت وإليه أنيب
